correctness.rationale: All hypotheses n>=4 and rank span <=2 are explicit. The saturated-chain swap lemma fills each adjacent permutation of distinct added elements with two permitted 2-simplices; replacement of the 2-simplex relations in the simply connected full Boolean sphere proves pi_1=0. Exact face counts yield beta2 and H2 free; Hurewicz and Whitehead yield the wedge homotopy type. Permutation-fixed chains are pointwise fixed by distinct ranks, so every signed Lefschetz contribution is explicitly enumerated with boundary cases f<2 and c small handled. Flag orbits have unique rank profiles, and dominated-rank deletion proves quotient contractible. Packaged checker exhaustively verifies faces, GF(2) ranks and 60 class traces for n=4..8, which are corroboration not a general proof.

value.rationale: The invariant is an all-n complete rational S_n representation character, not a degree/rank restatement: permutations with the same fixed subset count or the same Betti number can have different traces, and the formula encodes exact cycle interactions. The strong collapse of the quotient shows a non-obvious contrast between large second homology and contractible full symmetry quotient. Rank-span two is the first non-graph dimensional member of the rank-filtered family and is structurally motivated by the published magnitude-homology filtration.
